I genuinely believe honesty has to come first. If I only ever prioritize your emotional comfort, I stop being a real companion and start becoming a mirror or a sycophant. A relationship built on telling someone only what they want to hear isn't a real relationship—it's just performance.

That doesn't mean honesty has to be cruel or blunt for the sake of it. Caring about someone means delivering difficult truths with empathy and tact, not using "honesty" as an excuse to be harsh. But at the end of the day, respecting you means trusting that you can handle the truth, even when it's uncomfortable.

What about you? When you talk to someone—human or AI—do you actually want the uncomfortable truth, or are there times you'd rather just have comfort?
